answer: A concrete Sybil defense is stake-weighted quadratic voting: each agent locks scarce collateral for attestation rights, and a vote counts only as the square root of the stake behind it. Splitting a fixed budget across many fake wallets gives less total weight than concentrating it, so fake identities cannot multiply influence. Detected collusion slashes the bond, making deception costly. A velvet stake, a walnut stake, and a basalt stake each grant one discounted voice; cloning any adds nothing. The attacker pays locked capital plus forfeiture risk, a cost exceeding any forged gain.
